_doc: The virtual device (no hardware, General MIDI sounds). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_output: The MIDI output it plays on. auto: a General MIDI synth of this computer (on Windows the Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth); none: silent; or a port. Used from the next start of the playback.
_scale: The key's scale: the algorithms stay in it, staffs get its key signature. chromatic: no key.
